name: Text recognition and visual look up (Live Text, Visual Look Up, ML Kit)
plain: Reads text in images and scans documents on device.
meaning: Apps can recognise text, scan pages and identify objects in photos. Visual Look Up and Live Text work inside the system apps with no code.

android.prompt_ui: Camera permission for live; none for static images
android.api_surface: ML Kit Text Recognition v2, ML Kit Document Scanner, Google Lens
android.note: ML Kit Document Scanner needs no camera permission as it uses Play services UI.

ios.permission: None for images; camera permission for live
ios.prompt_ui: Camera prompt for live; none for photos
ios.note: Visual Look Up uses Apple models and may call servers for landmarks.

limits.headline: Can pick out text in pictures and scan documents on your phone
limits.user_action: You tap Scan document, point the camera at text, or open a photo
can: Pick out the words in a photo or live camera view
Scan a document without the camera permission on Android, using Google's scanner
Look up landmarks and plants on iPhone, with Apple's servers if needed
cannot: Use the live camera without you allowing the camera
Look at photos you did not open or share
Keep working fully offline on iPhone for landmark look up
limits.reach_label: Only what you scan or open
limits.differs: Both need a camera prompt for live scanning. Android's document scanner uses Google's screen, so it needs no camera permission.

story.what_it_is: Reads text in pictures and scans documents on the phone.

marketing.name: Live Text and Visual Look Up
marketing.pitch: Apple lets you copy text from a photo and learn about objects, plants and landmarks in pictures.

marketing.name: ML Kit text recognition
marketing.pitch: Google offers on device text recognition in ML Kit for reading text from images.

story.for_you: You point the camera at a page and can copy the words, or tap a plant in a photo to learn its name. It works on the phone, though some lookups ask a server.
story.for_makers: Makers add scanning, receipts and ID capture without building their own system. It also turns photos into searchable data, which brings privacy questions.

use_cases.example: A bank app reads a check or card number from a photo.
A scanner app turns a paper receipt into a text file.
A traveler copies a hotel address from a sign.
A shopping app reads a barcode or label.
A student scans a page into notes.
A person with low vision has a sign read aloud.
An AR game reads text from a real poster to unlock a clue.

story.android_note: Camera permission for live scans. The ML Kit Document Scanner needs no camera permission.
story.ios_note: Camera prompt for live scans. Visual Look Up may call Apple servers for landmarks.

technical_bounds: Quality varies with language and lighting

history.change: Live Text in apps and DataScanner
